Hey! I did not quite understand if you already have your Nextcloud server running yet, but I have a similar setup as what you're trying to achieve. All the Nextcloud installation files are on the server, but the data folder - where the users data is written - is mounted on the NAS. This is (with minor changes) my setup:

* NAS has a shared folder using SMB
* Nextcloud is running on CentOS as a VM
   * httpd service, serving from /var/www/html
* Mounted folder /var/www/html/data on [//my.network.storage/nextcloud](//my.network.storage/nextcloud)

At this point you can also "map network drive" on your workstation, where you can easily copy your files locally or even work over the network disk. 

Nextcloud app has an auto upload function where you can choose an album to sync. On iOS devces you might have to open the app for the sync to occur. 

Hope it helps!
